hash_seed_note: Re-measured 16 Sep 2026 by running each builder under four PYTHONHASHSEEDs (0, 1, 7, 4242) and comparing the bytes it writes. Eight of the eleven were already stable - earlier sorted()/tiebreak work had fixed them and the list was stale. build_trends.py (five tiebreaks) and build_network_sensitivity.py (tie-aware betweenness ranking) are repaired and verified stable. build_ot.py remains: it is also behind its published page, so it cannot be re-run to test. PYTHONHASHSEED=0 stays pinned as the floor, not the repair.
note: Builders whose committed output they no longer reproduce. Measured by repro_audit.py + the page re-test, both run 11 Sep 2026. `unsafe` means re-running the builder would overwrite a PUBLISHED PAGE with a body that is behind it - runner.py refuses these.
